title: Weight of a closed ball as the integral of the multiplicity
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ and U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ}. Let V = v(M, θ) be a rectifiable n-varifold in U (RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) with carrier M and multiplicity θ. Let x ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ} and r ∈ ℝ be such that the closed ball B_r(x) ⊆ U. Then μ_V(B_r(x)) = ENNReal.ofReal(∫_{M ∩ B_r(x)} θ dHⁿ), where Hⁿ = μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (x : Amb n ℓ) (r : ℝ), closedBall x r ⊆ U → V.weight (closedBall x r) = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z in V.carrier ∩ closedBall x r, V.mult z ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)))
